city_center.notes: Reno sits between the Sierra Nevada and the Great Basin Desert, gateway to Lake Tahoe; the Truckee River runs through downtown and the Riverwalk anchors the district, with local farmers markets across the region. cultural_notes: Reno is nestled between the Sierra Nevada and the Great Basin Desert -- the gateway to historic mining towns, Indigenous (Washoe/Paiute) culture, and year-round outdoor adventure (source: nationalgeographic.com Reno-Tahoe essential guide; visitrenotahoe.com heritage)

Lake Tahoe, the 'Jewel of the Sierra Nevada', is a summertime paradise and winter wonderland encircled by alpine peaks and ski resorts, 45 minutes up the hill from Reno (source: travelnevada.com Reno to Lake Tahoe loop)
the region blends Native American and Basque cultures, silver-mining heritage and Western traditions (source: visitrenotahoe.com Reno history and culture)
the Washoe people are the Indigenous stewards of the Lake Tahoe basin; any tribal reference stays consent-gated -- no fabricated endorsement (INFERRED framing; verify + honor sovereignty)
